AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app provides tools for generating AI music, podcasts, and managing user content. Operational Patterns: - Use 'openLibrary' and 'openHome' to switch between major app navigational sections. - Prefer 'searchForContent' over navigating manually when the user wants to find a specific track. Constraints: - Text prompts for 'strikeVibe' must describe musical atmospheres, not user commands. - Always ensure explicit user confirmation before invoking 'narratePOV' as it will immediately stream from the device camera and microphone.
